output.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as tech giant reshapes its workforce
output.summary: Microsoft's voluntary buyout covers about 60,000 eligible employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce, across multiple countries.

output.title: Anthropic files SEC paperwork as AI giant prepares for major IPO
output.summary: Anthropic filed its pre-IPO prospectus with the SEC ahead of the tech giant's highly-anticipated debut on the Nasdaq later this year as it seeks capital for the AI buildout.

output.title: Microsoft says its AI tool outperforms generalist doctors in complex diagnoses
output.summary: Microsoft's new orchestrator AI diagnoses complex medical cases by simulating a panel of clinical experts, outperforming general physicians in accuracy.
